name: ShowHiddenChannels
author: JustOptimize (Oggetto)
description: A plugin which displays all hidden Channels and allows users to view information about them, this won't allow you to read them (impossible).

changelog.title: v6.16 - Obfuscated channels
items: Discord now hides the name, topic and permissions of hidden channels server-side. The lock screen says so instead of showing placeholder permissions, bitrate and forum info.
Clicking a voice channel you can see but not join now opens a lock screen listing who can join it.

changelog.title: v6.15 - Discord Update
items: Fixed the plugin not working after Discord's rspack update (#294).

changelog.title: v6.14 - Discord Update
items: Fixed the hidden channel lock icon and role pills missing after a Discord update.
